name: Motorized Bicycle
description: Massachusetts's moped category: a pedal bicycle with a helper motor, or a non-pedal bicycle with a motor, with an automatic transmission and a top speed of no more than 30 mph. An e-bike that assists past 20 mph, or a pedal-less electric moped, lands here while it can't exceed 30 mph. Defined by Massachusetts General Laws chapter 90 §1 and regulated by §1B.

restrictions.rule: A pedal bicycle with a helper motor or a non-pedal bicycle with a motor, and an automatic transmission
Capable of no more than 30 mph; the definition also caps an engine at 50 cc
Not an electric bicycle (Class 1 or Class 2), and not a motor vehicle
May not be ridden faster than 25 mph
Riders must be 16 or older and hold a valid driver's license or learner's permit; a learner's permit holder needs no accompanying driver
Every rider and passenger must wear a helmet meeting the registrar's standards
Must comply with the federal motor vehicle safety standards that apply to it
The seller affixes a numbered RMV sticker or plate, renewed every two years
May use all public ways and bike lanes beside them, except limited-access or express state highways posted against bicycles
Barred from off-street recreational bicycle paths
